rules.title: Test rules
rules.timer: You get {value} minutes once you start. When the time runs out, the answers you marked are submitted automatically.
rules.tabs: Do not switch to another tab or window. The first time is a warning, the second ends the test.

consent.title: This lesson is monitored by camera
consent.body: Your attention is checked through the camera while the video plays. If you look away for too long you will be warned and the video will pause.
consent.privacy: The camera image never leaves this device: all analysis runs in your browser, and frames are neither stored nor uploaded. Only an 'attentive / looked away' marker is recorded.
consent.requiredHint: This lesson cannot be watched without a camera.

warning.title: You looked away
warning.lookingAway: You are looking away from the screen.
warning.noFace: Your face is not visible in the camera.
warning.resumeHint: Look back at the screen — the video resumes automatically.

lockout.title: Video temporarily locked
lockout.body: You looked away several times. Wait a moment and return to the lesson.

denied.title: Camera access denied
denied.body: To watch this monitored lesson, allow camera access in your browser settings.
denied.noBypass: This lesson cannot be watched without a camera.

error.title: Camera failed to start
error.body: The camera could not be started. Another application may be using it.

admin.title: Camera attention monitoring
admin.globalHint: The default rule for every course. Any course can change it on its own page.
admin.courseHint: This course only. Fields left untouched follow the global rule in Settings.
admin.resetDone: Course reset to the global rule
admin.inheritingAll: This course follows the global rule entirely

enabled.label: Enable attention monitoring
enabled.hint: When on, the learner is asked for camera access before the video starts.

pauseOnWarning.label: Pause the video on a warning
pauseOnWarning.hint: The video pauses when a warning appears and resumes once they look back.

requireRewatch.label: Require re-watching missed parts
requireRewatch.hint: Inattentive seconds are not credited as watched — the learner has to go back over them.

graceSeconds.label: Seconds before a warning
graceSeconds.hint: A warning fires only after this many seconds of continuous looking away. 1-60.

lockoutAfterWarnings.label: Lock after this many warnings
lockoutAfterWarnings.hint: The player locks temporarily after this many warnings. 0 = never lock.

lockoutSeconds.label: Lockout length (seconds)
lockoutSeconds.hint: How long the player stays locked. 5-300.

notifyManagerAfter.label: Notify manager after this many
notifyManagerAfter.hint: If a learner looks away this many times on one video, their manager is notified. 0 = never.

captureOnForeignFace.label: Photograph when a foreign face appears
captureOnForeignFace.hint: If a second face appears on camera, one frame is captured, uploaded and an admin is notified. Tell the employee beforehand — this is biometric personal data.

report.title: Attention
report.cameraBlocked: Camera was not running — these figures are incomplete

facePolicy.title: Face verification
facePolicy.hint: Applies to every course. Enrolment and per-employee status stay on the employee page.

verifyEveryOpen.label: Require a face check for every video, material and test
verifyEveryOpen.hint: Off: an employee passes one check a day. On: the camera check is asked for again before each video, each material and each test they open.

panel.title: Verify your identity
panel.body: A quick camera check is needed before you continue. This is only asked once a day.
panel.privacy: The camera image is used only for this check and is not stored.
panel.failedBody: Make sure your face is clearly visible and lighting is sufficient, then try again.
panel.lockedBody: Verification is temporarily locked after repeated failed attempts. Try again later or contact an administrator.

enrollment.guidance: Look at the camera. Keep your face inside the frame.
enrollment.selfIntro: Register your face once to open lessons, materials and tests. We'll take a few frames — next time the check compares against this photo.
